turn.text: how do I create a pivot table?
turn.reply: To create a PivotTable, click any cell inside your data range. Then, go to the Insert tab, find the Tables group, and click the "PivotTable" button. You can also use "Recommended PivotTables" for suggestions. In the PivotTable panel, drag and drop your fields into the four areas: grouping fields go to Rows and Columns, numeric fields you want summarized go to Values (they sum by default), and fields for filtering the results go to Filters.

turn.reply: XLOOKUP is a powerful function in Icecream Sheets (and Excel) that allows you to search for a value in one range (the lookup array) and return a corresponding value from another range (the return array). It's a more flexible and modern replacement for older lookup functions like VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP. Key features include searching in any direction (left or right, up or down), approximate matching, and handling cases where a lookup value is not found.
